variants.name: ew-redeploy
variants.note: control: the live executor with the redeploy of idle cash (_live_options + midcycle_redeploy), no trims

variants.name: trim-runup-20
variants.note: a held name whose weight has drifted to 1.5x its target is trimmed back to target mid-cycle; the redeploy puts the proceeds to work

variants.name: trim-rsi
variants.note: 14-session RSI above 80 halves the name's target until the RSI is under 60; the redeploy or the reset restores it

variants.name: trim-band
variants.note: a close more than one sigma above the upper 20-day Bollinger band (z > 3 in sigma units) halves the name's target until the close is back inside the band (z < 2)

variants.name: dip-add
variants.note: a held A/A+ name more than 8% under its 21-session EMA has its target raised to 1.5x (capped at the 20% hold limit), paid from cash and pro-rata trims of the others; restored at the next reset

variants.name: trim-dd-forecast
variants.note: the names whose CNN 20-session drawdown forecast is in the worst decile of the day's A/A+ book are halved until they leave it

variants.name: trim-dd-forecast-stop
variants.note: trim-dd-forecast plus a full exit to the next reset when the close is 15% below the close on the trim date

note: Every variant is one registered trial, fixed in VARIANTS before the run: the live executor with the redeploy of idle cash (the control) plus one trim or dip rule through the allocator wrapper and the weight_filter hook with midcycle_trims. Lines priced on identical sessions from each of the first `offsets` sessions of the restricted report; medians and worsts across offsets; paired statistics at the median offset against the control; trim statistics pooled across offsets over the actions in the window; the forward reading is the name's close FORWARD_SESSIONS later over the action's close.

verdict.text: 2016-2023 at 25 bp: control 24.8% CAGR, median max drawdown -43.2%, invested 91.2%. Variants against the control (CAGR points, all attributable to the rule): trim-runup-20 -1.6 pt (t -1.76, 2024-2026 -0.9 bp/d, DD +0.5/+0.0 pt; 31.0 trims/yr, sold too early 62.4%; exposure-adjusted -1.4 pt, 0/20 offsets above the control) RECORD; trim-rsi -1.1 pt (t -0.45, 2024-2026 -2.5 bp/d, DD +0.1/-0.0 pt; 5.9 trims/yr, sold too early 51.8%; exposure-adjusted -0.9 pt, 0/20 offsets above the control) RECORD; trim-band -0.9 pt (t -0.31, 2024-2026 -1.0 bp/d, DD -0.2/+0.1 pt; 5.5 trims/yr, sold too early 61.6%; exposure-adjusted -0.9 pt, 0/20 offsets above the control) RECORD; dip-add +0.0 pt (t +2.00, 2024-2026 -0.7 bp/d, DD +0.1/+0.0 pt; 0.0 trims/yr, sold too early n/a; exposure-adjusted +0.0 pt, 12/20 offsets above the control) RECORD; trim-dd-forecast -3.4 pt (t -2.76, 2024-2026 -2.4 bp/d, DD +1.1/+3.2 pt; 27.7 trims/yr, sold too early 58.0%; exposure-adjusted -2.8 pt, 0/20 offsets above the control) RECORD; trim-dd-forecast-stop -3.6 pt (t -2.79, 2024-2026 -2.7 bp/d, DD +1.1/+3.2 pt; 28.0 trims/yr, sold too early 58.3%; exposure-adjusted -2.9 pt, 0/20 offsets above the control) RECORD. No rule clears 1 pt with t >= 2, not worse on 2024-2026 and drawdown within 3 pt; every priced rule is RECORD.
